source: Windows Mobile 6.1 Professional ROM (VGA, 192 dpi) via Device Emulator; Yozora #709
note: This ROM is a VGA build: most modules ship only the 192-dpi resource DLL, so many 1x files are flagged "downscaled" (box filter from the 2x art) or use a native 32 px frame. See per-item flags.

status-data-off.notes: Connectivity, not connected (arrows with x), as in ref/today.png.

status-signal-search-1.notes: Antenna + 1 dot; with -2/-3 probably the searching-for-service sequence. No ascending signal-bar icons exist in this ROM dump.

status-data-anim-00.notes: Data arrows sequence 4744-4761 (frames in id order); probably the connecting/transfer animation. Frame 00 = both arrows, no tails.

title-close.notes: Glyph only (white, alpha from mask). Canvas is the whole title-bar cell: at 2x x=433..478, y=0..51 on a 480-wide screen. The green button behind it is drawn (see README/report).

title-ok.notes: Glyph only, same cell as title-close.

sip-keyboard.notes: White keyboard glyph (identical to shellres.192 icon 5081). msim.dll 1x icon 15376 is the older grey 2-bpp keyboard art (different design), so 1x is downscaled.

app-today-lg.notes: No 96-dpi resource in this VGA ROM; 1x uses the native 32x32 frame of the 192-dpi group (the 2x small-icon art), not a resample.

app-programs-lg.notes: No 96-dpi resource in this VGA ROM; 1x uses the native 32x32 frame of the 192-dpi group (the 2x small-icon art), not a resample.

app-settings-lg.notes: No 96-dpi resource in this VGA ROM; 1x uses the native 32x32 frame of the 192-dpi group (the 2x small-icon art), not a resample.

app-help-lg.notes: No 96-dpi resource in this VGA ROM; 1x uses the native 32x32 frame of the 192-dpi group (the 2x small-icon art), not a resample.

app-search-lg.notes: No 96-dpi resource in this VGA ROM; 1x uses the native 32x32 frame of the 192-dpi group (the 2x small-icon art), not a resample.

app-games-lg.notes: No 96-dpi resource in this VGA ROM; 1x uses the native 32x32 frame of the 192-dpi group (the 2x small-icon art), not a resample.

app-phone.notes: Phone app (cprog.exe) not in the dump; shellres icon 13953 is the blue handset shown in ref/startmenu.png.

app-phone-lg.notes: No 96-dpi resource in this VGA ROM; 1x uses the native 32x32 frame of the 192-dpi group (the 2x small-icon art), not a resample.

app-office.notes: Office Mobile folder (icon 7690; 7691 is a variant without 1x).

app-calendar.notes: One multi-size group (16/32/64): the 32 frame is both 1x large and 2x small.

app-contacts.notes: One multi-size group (16/32/64): the 32 frame is both 1x large and 2x small.

app-ie.notes: One multi-size group (16/32/64): the 32 frame is both 1x large and 2x small.

app-messaging.notes: One multi-size group (16/32/64): the 32 frame is both 1x large and 2x small.

app-file-explorer.notes: One multi-size group (16/32/64): the 32 frame is both 1x large and 2x small.

app-pictures.notes: One multi-size group (16/32/64): the 32 frame is both 1x large and 2x small.

app-notes.notes: One multi-size group (16/32/64): the 32 frame is both 1x large and 2x small.

app-task-manager.notes: No 32px frame in shellresapps.192; 2x small uses the 96-dpi large frame (native 32px). 1x small is taskmgr.exe icon 1 (16px).

app-task-manager-lg.notes: shellresapps icon 20228 (20229 is a darker variant; 20228 matches ref/programs.png).

app-director.notes: Not ROM art: the Director is a Dreamscape app with its own icon (no WM stock counterpart). @4x is 64 px. Start menu (wmDirector.js).

app-director-lg.notes: Large Director icon (Programs-style 32 px); @4x is 128 px. Not ROM art.

today-phone.notes: Wireless "Phone off" item. shellres icon 13999 is the 64px variant of the same art.

today-getting-started.notes: coreres.dll (96 dpi) 32px frame; matches ref/today.png pixel for pixel. coreres.192.dll only has a 64px frame. 20798 is identical.

today-search-button.notes: Live Search button, normal state (32x30). WLMHSSearchBarResources GIF 101 (240x32) is the search bar artwork.

menu-check.notes: Mask glyph (black, recolour at runtime: menus draw it in the item text colour, e.g. #087D10 in ref/menu-submenu.png). 2x matches the ref exactly.

menu-submenu-arrow.notes: Mask glyph; glyph 4x7 (1x) / 8x15 (2x), padded with one transparent row at the bottom to keep 2:1. Ref shows 14 rows at 2x (last 1px row clipped by the menu).

wait-0.notes: 16-bpp opaque tile, includes its light square backing; no mask or colour key in the ROM.

fe-folder.notes: File Explorer list: folder (small icon of the VGA shell, as ref/list-fileexplorer.png).

fe-file.notes: File Explorer list: file with no associated program (p3.png mxip_lang).

2x.source: shellres.192.dll bmp_19712 crop 32x32+0+0, rgb(192,192,192) key to alpha

fe-device.notes: File Explorer folder bar: My Device (image list 19712 cell 0; cells 1-3 are Storage Card, network, pictures).

msg-acct-mail.notes: Messaging account picker: an e-mail account (Dreamscape: an agent's Dovecote mailbox).

msg-attach-mail.notes: Message list: a message with attachments (envelope with a paper clip).

outres.192.dll bitmap 22002 frame 1, #FF00FF key made transparent
outres.192.dll bitmap 22002 frame 2, #FF00FF key made transparent

outres.192.dll bitmap 22002 frame 5, #FF00FF key made transparent

msg-folder-account.notes: Folder list: the account itself (the tray of folders).

notes-folders.notes: Notes folder bar: All Folders (stacked folders), ref-notes/n-list.png.

notes-note.notes: Notes list row icon (the yellow note).

notDelivered.status-signal-0..5: No ascending signal-bar icons in the dump (only antenna + 1-3 dots, exported as status-signal-search-*). tshres bmp 12302 holds Wi-Fi network bars (colour, list use).
notDelivered.status-data-active: No distinct active icon; see status-data-anim-00..17.
notDelivered.sip-arrow: Drawn, not a resource: white filled triangle 13x7 at 2x (rows 1,3,...,13 px), at x=266..278, y=606..612 in ref/sip.png.
notDelivered.dropdown-arrow: Drawn: black filled triangle 13x7 at 2x (13,11,...,1 px rows). shellresapps icon 13332 is a different, taller arrow.
notDelivered.windows-flag: Not exported (copyright rule; use the Melaton emblem). shellres.192 icon 4609 is 41x36 at 2x, drawn at x=4, y=8 of the 50 px title bar; no 1x flag in this ROM. A 2 px vertical separator follows at x=50..51 (2x), y=7..45, gradient #004918 at the ends to #84C35A at y=26.
